judgment.summary: A deep reserve guard with a handful of games, not a fantasy factor.

reasons.text: The base of 32 minutes is a fallback from 11 tanking-team games last season. He played 12 in preseason and is not on the depth chart, so 11 minutes in Yahoo's 11 games.
The base per-minute rates mix Yahoo's low line with 32 minutes, which understates his rate per minute. His real rate is about 0.43 points and 0.2 assists per minute, so I raised the rates.
